description: This file defines the DeviceIdentity struct, along with related enums and functions for managing device identities, including key generation, signing payloads, and file storage.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: A struct representing a device's identity, including device ID, public key, private key, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityPaths
classes.description: An enum providing methods to determine the directory path for storing device identity data.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityStore
classes.description: An enum providing methods to load, create, sign payloads, and save device identity data.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Determines the directory URL for storing device state, checking environment variables and default locations.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads existing device identity data from file or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a payload string using the device's private key, returning a base64 URL-encoded signature.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device identity with a new key pair and device ID based on the public key hash.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes data into a URL-safe base64 string.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the device's public key in URL-safe base64 encoding.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the device identity data to a file.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the file URL for storing the device identity JSON.
